title: At the crossroads of calcium signaling, protein synthesis and neuropeptide release
abstract: By influencing calcium homeostasis, local protein synthesis and the endoplasmic reticulum, a small protein called Rab10 emerges as a crucial cytoplasmic regulator of neuropeptide secretion.

affiliations.institution: Laboratory of Molecular Neuroscience, German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE)
